leadText: The Decision and the Tournament of Six (Japanese: 決定！！６人トーナメント！ Decision!! 6-Person Tournament!) is the fourth chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.
plainText:
The Decision and the Tournament of Six (Japanese: 決定！！６人トーナメント！ Decision!! 6-Person Tournament!) is the fourth chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
and arrive at Iki Town, where the festival commences.
Moon is enlisted by Olivia to help decide the placement of the tournament entrees.
Moon meets Lillie.
Lillie's , Nebby, runs off, forcing Moon, Lillie, and Olivia to chase after it to Mahalo Trail.
Moon discovers a strange crack in the sky.
Moon saves Nebby from a flock of wild , but Nebby causes the bridge they were standing on to be destroyed.
Moon and Nebby are saved by .
After learning that Lillie was entered in the tournament as a mistake, Moon decides to take her place instead.
The final participant in the tournament is revealed to be Gladion.
Sun starts his battle against the Masked Royal.
